head.margin: Reproducibility crisis has higher academic impact than solar O&M
head.why: Nuskha solves a universal, high-stakes research problem with novel multi-agent verification and 1M-context understanding; Thikana is physically impressive but niche.
head.virality_pick: Nuskha - visual reproduction receipts and 'irreproducible' verdicts resonate with every researcher's pain
head.risk_note: Nuskha's dry-run fallback ensures demo cannot die; Thikana's physical dependency riskier

verdict.one_line: Nuskha solves reproducibility crisis with verifiable research receipts; Thikana is impressive but narrower in scope.
